title: RoboSimStudio: An Interactive Toolkit for Rapid Real2Sim of Robot Manipulation Tasks
title_zh: RoboSimStudio:用于机器人操作任务快速“真实到模拟”的交互式工具包

paragraphs.en: It is difficult to accurately model the physics of the interaction between a robot and the objects it manipulates, including contact mechanics, coupled contact dynamics, deformations. stiffness and friction. We present RoboSimStudio (RSS), an interactive toolkit that makes choices of solver, contact model, and physical parameters explicit and editable, allowing both humans and coding agents to iteratively refine simulations based on observed physical behavior. We implement RSS with the open Newton physics simulation system and describe experiments with human-guided real2sim using (1) visual evaluation, (2) force-feedback and (3) agentic Real2Sim2Real. Code, video and additional information can be found on project website: https://robosimstudio.github.io
paragraphs.zh: 要精确模拟机器人与其所操作物体之间的相互作用物理过程十分困难，这包括接触力学、耦合接触动力学、形变、刚度和摩擦。 我们提出了 RoboSimStudio (RSS)，这是一款交互式工具包，它将求解器、接触模型和物理参数的选择显式化且可编辑，使人类和编码智能体都能根据观察到的物理行为迭代优化模拟。 我们基于开源的 Newton 物理模拟系统实现了 RSS，并描述了由人类引导的 real2sim 实验，包括 (1) 视觉评估、(2) 力反馈以及 (3) 智能体驱动 Real2Sim2Real。 代码、视频及更多信息可在项目网站获取：https://robosimstudio.github.io

paragraphs.en: Simulating robot manipulation requires modeling the interaction between a robot and the objects it manipulates, including robot kinematics, coupled contact dynamics, and deformation (Figure 7(b) ). Emerging simulation frameworks, such as Newton [ 3 ] , Genesis [ 6 ] , and SuperDex [ 4 ] , increasingly cover these different forms of physics by supporting rigid, articulated, and deformable-body simulation within a common framework. However, accurately modeling robot manipulation behavior to match real-world physics, or Real2Sim, still requires choosing appropriate physics models, contact models, and physical parameters, and iteratively refining these choices against observed behavior. In this paper, we extend existing simulation frameworks to streamline Real2Sim.
paragraphs.zh: 模拟机器人操作需要对机器人与其操作的物体之间的相互作用进行建模，包括机器人运动学、耦合接触动力学和形变（图 7(b)）。 新兴的仿真框架，如 Newton [3]、Genesis [6] 和 SuperDex [4]，通过在统一框架内支持刚体、可动关节体和可变形体的仿真，越来越能覆盖这些不同形式的物理现象。 然而，要准确模拟机器人操作行为以匹配真实世界的物理特性（即 Real2Sim），仍然需要选择合适的物理模型、接触模型和物理参数，并基于观察到的行为对这些选择进行迭代优化。 在本文中，我们扩展了现有的仿真框架，以简化 Real2Sim 的过程。

paragraphs.en: We recognize that both humans and LLM coding agents share a fundamental interaction pattern for Real2Sim: they modify a scene, execute physical interactions, observe discrepancies, and refine the model based on feedback. Specifically, humans perform this loop through direct manipulation and immediate visual or force feedback, while coding agents [ 1 , 2 ] use iterative reasoning and acting [ 7 ] to inspect simulator states and revise scene configurations and robot behaviors. Motivated by this insight, we make multi-physics simulations directly interactive and editable by both humans and coding agents to enable rapid iterative Real2Sim refinement.
paragraphs.zh: 我们认识到，人类和 LLM 编码智能体在 Real2Sim 中都遵循一种基本的交互模式：它们修改场景、执行物理交互、观察差异，并根据反馈优化模型。 具体来说，人类通过直接操作以及即时视觉或力反馈来完成这一循环，而编码智能体 [ 1 , 2 ] 则通过迭代推理与行动 [ 7 ] 来检查模拟器的状态，并修正场景配置和机器人行为。 基于这一认识，我们使多物理场模拟对人类和编码智能体都具备直接交互和编辑的能力，从而实现 Real2Sim 的快速迭代优化。

paragraphs.en: We present RoboSimStudio (RSS), an interactive toolkit for physics-based simulation of robot manipulation tasks. It uses Viser [ 8 ] and Newton [ 3 ] for multi-physics simulation, supports co-simulation with external physics engines, and makes choices of solver, contact model, and physical parameters explicit and editable. An interactive display and sliders allow a human or AI coding agent [ 1 , 2 ] to rapidly adjust parameters to align with a real robot and environment. For coding agents, RoboSimStudio exposes simulator state together with spatial-temporal text and visual feedback, allowing agents to observe the consequences of their changes and iteratively refine the simulation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 RoboSimStudio (RSS)，这是一个用于基于物理的机器人操作任务模拟的交互式工具包。 它使用 Viser [ 8 ] 和 Newton [ 3 ] 进行多物理场模拟，支持与外部物理引擎的联合仿真，并允许显式选择和编辑求解器、接触模型及物理参数。 交互式显示和滑块使人类或 AI 编码智能体 [ 1 , 2 ] 能够快速调整参数，以匹配真实机器人和环境。 对于编码智能体，RoboSimStudio 提供了模拟器的状态信息以及时空文本和视觉反馈，使智能体能够观察其改动带来的后果，并迭代优化模拟过程。

paragraphs.en: We conduct evaluation on RoboSimStudio through human-guided and agentic Real2Sim experiments. Using the interactive studio, we construct 18 contact-rich manipulation simulations involving rigid objects, articulated mechanisms, cables, cloth, and soft-body deformation. We further demonstrate force-feedback interaction, where a human operator can control a simulated robot and perceive contact forces through a low-cost leader arm. Finally, we conduct a pilot study of agentic Real2Sim2Real using a bimanual sponge-wiping task (Figure 1 ). Given a smartphone video of the real task, off-the-shelf coding agents construct multi-physics simulations. A Graph-as-Policy (GaP) [ 5 ] is then improved using simulation feedback and transferred to the real robot. We also demonstrate how a real-world failure can be used to guide an agent to revise the simulation’s physical constraints.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过人类引导和智能体主导的 Real2Sim 实验，在 RoboSimStudio 上开展评估。 借助交互式工作室，我们构建了 18 个富含接触动作的操控模拟场景，涉及刚性物体、铰接机构、电缆、布料以及软体变形。 我们还展示了力反馈交互：人类操作者可以通过一个低成本的前导臂控制模拟机器人，并感知接触力。 最后，我们针对双手动海绵擦拭任务（图 1），开展了一项智能体主导的 Real2Sim2Real 初步研究。 给定一段真实任务的智能手机视频，现成的编码智能体即可构建多物理场模拟。 随后，一个图-即策略（GaP）[5] 模型通过模拟反馈得到优化，并迁移到真实机器人上。 我们还展示了如何利用现实世界中的故障来引导智能体修正模拟中的物理约束。

paragraphs.en: In summary, this work makes three contributions: (1) RoboSimStudio, a simulation toolkit with configurable contact models and physical parameters for contact-rich robot manipulation; (2) Interactive interfaces on RoboSimStudio for humans and coding agents that streamline Real2Sim process; (3) 18 manipulation tasks with visual and force-feedback interaction, and a pilot study on real2sim2real with RoboSimStudio that coding agents construct a multi-physics simulation from a smartphone video.
paragraphs.zh: 总而言之，本研究有三项贡献：(1) RoboSimStudio，一个具备可配置接触模型和物理参数的模拟工具包，适用于接触频繁的机器人操作；(2) RoboSimStudio 上的交互式界面，供人类和编码智能体使用，从而简化 Real2Sim 流程；(3) 18 项包含视觉和力反馈交互的操作任务，以及一项关于 RoboSimStudio 的 real2sim2real 初步研究，其中编码智能体根据智能手机视频构建了一个多物理场模拟。

paragraphs.en: Physics simulation has enabled large-scale robot learning by providing environments for policy training and evaluation. MuJoCo [ 9 ] supports articulated robot dynamics and contact-rich manipulation, while GPU-accelerated frameworks such as Isaac Gym and Isaac Lab [ 10 , 11 , 12 ] , ManiSkill3 [ 13 ] , MuJoCo Playground [ 14 ] , and Genesis [ 6 ] support parallel simulation for robot learning. Frameworks such as robosuite [ 15 ] further provide standardized manipulation environments. More recently, Newton [ 3 ] , built on Warp [ 16 ] , integrates multiple physics solvers, including MuJoCo-Warp [ 17 ] , Vertex Block Descent (VBD) [ 18 ] , and XPBD [ 19 ] . Other physics engines, such as SuperDex [ 4 ] , provide specialized models for contact-rich soft-body simulation. While these frameworks provide increasingly diverse physics capabilities, constructing manipulation environments still requires selecting appropriate solvers, configuring contact models, and tuning physical parameters. RoboSimStudio builds on Newton and supports co-simulation with external physics engines, allowing different physics models to be composed within the same scene and interactively refined by humans and coding agents.
paragraphs.zh: 物理模拟通过为策略训练和评估提供环境，使得大规模机器人学习成为可能。 MuJoCo [ 9 ] 支持铰接式机器人动力学和富含接触的操控任务，而 GPU 加速框架（如 Isaac Gym 和 Isaac Lab [ 10 , 11 , 12 ]、ManiSkill3 [ 13 ]、MuJoCo Playground [ 14 ] 以及 Genesis [ 6 ]）则支持机器人学习的并行模拟。 robosuite [ 15 ] 等框架进一步提供了标准化的操控环境。 近期，基于 Warp [ 16 ] 构建的 Newton [ 3 ] 集成了多种物理求解器，包括 MuJoCo-Warp [ 17 ]、Vertex Block Descent (VBD) [ 18 ] 和 XPBD [ 19 ]。 其他物理引擎（如 SuperDex [ 4 ]）则为富含接触的软体模拟提供了专用模型。 尽管这些框架提供了日益多样化的物理能力，构建操控环境仍然需要选择合适的求解器、配置接触模型并调整物理参数。 RoboSimStudio 基于 Newton 构建，支持与外部物理引擎的联合模拟，允许在同一场景内组合不同的物理模型，并由人类和编码智能体进行交互式优化。

paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs) have been increasingly used in robotics for task planning, robot control, and policy generation. Early approaches use language models to ground instructions in robot affordances [ 20 ] , generate plans and executable robot programs [ 21 , 22 , 23 , 24 ] , and improve robot behavior through feedback [ 25 ] . More recent works use LLMs to generate reward functions [ 26 , 27 ] , visual question answering [ 28 , 29 ] , domain randomization strategies [ 30 ] , and simulation tasks for robot learning [ 31 , 32 , 33 ] . With iterative reasoning and acting frameworks such as ReAct [ 7 ] , general-purpose coding agents [ 1 , 2 ] can modify code, execute programs, and refine their solutions based on feedback. Such agents have been applied to reconstructing articulated objects [ 34 ] , robot data collection [ 35 ] , and iterative policy improvement, such as CaP-X [ 36 ] and GaP [ 5 ] . A coding agent has also solved the Push-T benchmark without demonstrations by running its own experiments in simulation [ 37 ] . The effectiveness of these agents also depends on their ability to interact with external environments and access execution feedback [ 38 ] . RoboSimStudio builds on this insight by providing coding agents with an interactive physics simulation environment, where scene configurations, physics models, and simulation feedback are directly accessible for iterative Real2Sim construction and refinement.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）在机器人领域被越来越多地用于任务规划、机器人控制和策略生成。 早期的方法利用语言模型将指令与机器人的可操作性特征关联起来 [ 20 ]，生成计划和可执行的机器人程序 [ 21 , 22 , 23 , 24 ]，并通过反馈改进机器人行为 [ 25 ]。 近期的研究则利用 LLM 生成奖励函数 [ 26 , 27 ]、进行视觉问答 [ 28 , 29 ]、制定领域随机化策略 [ 30 ]，以及为机器人学习生成模拟任务 [ 31 , 32 , 33 ]。 借助 ReAct [ 7 ] 这类迭代推理与执行框架，通用编码智能体 [ 1 , 2 ] 能够根据反馈修改代码、执行程序并优化解决方案。 此类智能体已被应用于重构铰接式物体 [ 34 ]、机器人数据收集 [ 35 ]，以及策略的迭代改进，例如 CaP-X [ 36 ] 和 GaP [ 5 ]。 一种编码智能体还通过在模拟环境中自主运行实验，无需演示便解决了 Push-T 基准测试问题 [ 37 ]。 这些智能体的有效性也取决于它们与外部环境互动以及获取执行反馈的能力 [ 38 ]。 RoboSimStudio 基于这一理念，为编码智能体提供了一个交互式物理模拟环境，其中场景配置、物理模型和模拟反馈均可直接访问，从而支持迭代的 Real2Sim 构建与优化。

sents.en: Such agents have been applied to reconstructing articulated objects [ 34 ] , robot data collection [ 35 ] , and iterative policy improvement, such as CaP-X [ 36 ] and GaP [ 5 ] .
sents.zh: 此类智能体已被应用于重构铰接式物体 [ 34 ]、机器人数据收集 [ 35 ]，以及策略的迭代改进，例如 CaP-X [ 36 ] 和 GaP [ 5 ]。

sents.en: A coding agent has also solved the Push-T benchmark without demonstrations by running its own experiments in simulation [ 37 ] .
sents.zh: 一种编码智能体还通过在模拟环境中自主运行实验，无需演示便解决了 Push-T 基准测试问题 [ 37 ]。

sents.en: The effectiveness of these agents also depends on their ability to interact with external environments and access execution feedback [ 38 ] .
sents.zh: 这些智能体的有效性也取决于它们与外部环境互动以及获取执行反馈的能力 [ 38 ]。

sents.en: RoboSimStudio builds on this insight by providing coding agents with an interactive physics simulation environment, where scene configurations, physics models, and simulation feedback are directly accessible for iterative Real2Sim construction and refinement.
sents.zh: RoboSimStudio 基于这一理念，为编码智能体提供了一个交互式物理模拟环境，其中场景配置、物理模型和模拟反馈均可直接访问，从而支持迭代的 Real2Sim 构建与优化。

paragraphs.en: Real2Sim approaches reconstruct simulation environments from real-world observations to support robot policy training and evaluation. Prior work has explored constructing digital twins and digital cousins from images, videos, and other observations [ 39 , 40 , 41 , 42 , 43 , 44 ] . Other approaches use generative models and LLMs to automatically construct simulation tasks, environments, and reward functions [ 31 , 45 , 46 , 27 ] , or generate robot policies directly [ 21 , 5 ] . Blox-Net [ 47 ] uses vision-language models to design block assemblies, refines the designs by perturbation analysis in simulation, and builds them with a real robot. These approaches reduce the effort required for scene construction and policy development, but often focus on specific reconstruction or generation pipelines. In contrast, RoboSimStudio provides a general-purpose interactive simulation toolkit where both humans and coding agents can construct, inspect, and refine multi-physics environments. By exposing physics models, contact parameters, and simulator-state feedback, RoboSimStudio supports iterative Real2Sim refinement based on observed physical behavior rather than scene generation alone.
paragraphs.zh: Real2Sim 方法通过从真实世界观察中重建模拟环境，为机器人策略的训练和评估提供支持。 先前的工作已探索了如何从图像、视频和其他观察数据中构建数字孪生和数字表亲 [ 39 , 40 , 41 , 42 , 43 , 44 ] 。 其他方法则利用生成模型和大型语言模型（LLM）自动构建模拟任务、环境和奖励函数 [ 31 , 45 , 46 , 27 ] ，或直接生成机器人策略 [ 21 , 5 ] 。 Blox-Net [ 47 ] 使用视觉-语言模型设计积木组合，通过模拟中的扰动分析优化这些设计，并用真实机器人将其搭建出来。 这些方法减少了场景构建和策略开发所需的工作量，但通常专注于特定的重建或生成流程。 相比之下，RoboSimStudio 提供了一个通用的交互式模拟工具包，人类和编码智能体都可以在其中构建、检查和优化多物理环境。 通过开放物理模型、接触参数和模拟器状态反馈，RoboSimStudio 支持基于观察到的物理行为的迭代 Real2Sim 优化，而不仅仅是依赖场景生成。

paragraphs.en: Figure 2 shows the architecture of RoboSimStudio. Physics is mainly provided by Newton [ 3 ] and its solvers, with external physics engines that can be co-simulated by exchanging contact and forces. RoboSimStudio composes a scene with robots, objects, and physics into one simulation while keeping modeling choices, including the solver, contact model, and physical parameters, explicit and editable. paragraphs.zh: 图 2 展示了 RoboSimStudio 的架构。 物理模拟主要由 Newton [ 3 ] 及其求解器提供，同时支持通过交换接触力和力来协同模拟的外部物理引擎。 RoboSimStudio 将机器人、物体和物理模拟整合到一个统一的仿真场景中，同时保持建模选项（包括求解器、接触模型和物理参数）的显式性和可编辑性。 该组合场景可通过代码、供人类使用的交互式工作室，或供编码智能体使用的迭代接口进行访问，以支持任务创建和智能体驱动的 real2sim。

paragraphs.en: Robot Interfaces. RoboSimStudio provides a common robot interface for Franka Panda, UR5e, and single- and bimanual YAM, and can be extended to additional robots. A robot is specified declaratively by its model, joints, mounting, and hand geometry, and exposes common interfaces for forward and inverse kinematics, motion generation, and control. Inverse kinematics supports interchangeable solvers, such as pyroki [ 48 ] , while motions include joint-space and Cartesian moves, guarded contact motions, and collision-aware planning, such as cuRobo [ 49 ] . Policies can command the robot in joint or end-effector action spaces, while privileged simulator state about manipulated objects is kept separate from observations available to the robot.
paragraphs.zh: 机器人接口。 RoboSimStudio 为 Franka Panda、UR5e 以及单臂和双臂 YAM 提供了通用的机器人接口，并且可以扩展至更多机器人。 机器人通过其模型、关节、安装方式和手部几何结构进行声明式定义，并提供了正向和反向运动学、运动生成及控制的通用接口。 反向运动学支持可互换的求解器，例如 pyroki [ 48 ]，而运动则包括关节空间和笛卡尔空间移动、受保护的接触运动以及考虑碰撞的规划，例如 cuRobo [ 49 ]。 策略可以在关节或末端执行器的动作空间中指挥机器人，同时关于被操作物体的特权模拟器状态会与机器人可获取的观察信息保持分离。

paragraphs.en: Multi-Physics Simulation and Coupling. Manipulation scenes often combine articulated robots, rigid objects, and deformable materials, for which no single physical model is sufficient. In RoboSimStudio, objects specify what they are, while the scene specifies which solver models each type of physics. By default, articulated robots use MuJoCo-Warp [ 17 ] , cables and cloth use Vertex Block Descent [ 18 ] , and soft bodies can be simulated by external engines [ 4 , 6 ] co-simulated with Newton. RoboSimStudio couples these solvers by exchanging contact forces between Newton solvers or poses and contact wrenches with external engines. The solver, coupling method, contact model, and material parameters remain explicit entries in the scene and can therefore be changed without rewriting the task. Figure 3 shows five manipulation tasks that use different physics solvers and coupling methods.
paragraphs.zh: 多物理场模拟与耦合。 操作场景通常结合关节机器人、刚体物体和可变形材料，而单一物理模型无法充分描述这些对象。 在 RoboSimStudio 中，物体定义其自身属性，而场景则指定每种物理类型应使用哪个求解器模型。 默认情况下，关节机器人使用 MuJoCo-Warp [ 17 ]，电缆和布料使用 Vertex Block Descent [ 18 ]，而软体则可通过外部引擎 [ 4 , 6 ] 与 Newton 进行联合模拟。 RoboSimStudio 通过 Newton 求解器之间交换接触力，或与外部引擎交换姿态和接触力矩，将这些求解器耦合在一起。 求解器、耦合方法、接触模型和材料参数在场景中仍以显式条目形式存在，因此无需重新编写任务即可进行更改。 图 3 展示了五个使用了不同物理求解器和耦合方法的操作任务。

paragraphs.en: Interactive Interface for Humans. Humans interact with RoboSimStudio through a browser-based studio built on Viser [ 8 ] . Objects can be selected, dragged, and inspected, and robot arms can be controlled directly, allowing a user to probe physical behavior before writing a policy. Each object’s inspector exposes its physical parameters with their units and ranges. Parameters such as stiffness and damping can be changed while the simulation is running, while parameters that require rebuilding the scene are marked explicitly. Figure 4 shows the same towel fold under four choices of bending and stretch stiffness, illustrating how simulation tuning becomes direct interaction with the resulting physical behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 面向人类的交互式界面。 人类通过基于 Viser [ 8 ] 的浏览器端工作室与 RoboSimStudio 进行交互。 用户可以选择、拖拽和检查物体，也可以直接控制机械臂，从而在编写策略之前就能探究物理行为。 每个物体的检查器都会显示其物理参数及其单位和范围。 在模拟运行期间可以更改刚度和阻尼等参数，而需要重建场景的参数则会明确标注。 图 4 展示了在四种弯曲和拉伸刚度选择下相同的毛巾折叠效果，说明了如何通过调整模拟参数直接交互于所产生的物理行为。

paragraphs.en: Iterative Interface for Agents. Given as input video of a real task being performed, a coding agent can tune a simulation through the same basic loop: modify the scene, execute a behavior, and observe the result. RoboSimStudio organizes a rollout into robot motion primitives and converts simulator state into spatial-temporal feedback that describes target error, object motion, contact events, grasping or slipping, and progress toward the task goal. Because this feedback is computed from simulator state, it exposes physical events such as contact that may be difficult to infer from images alone. Together with visual observations, this allows an agent to attribute an outcome to the action that caused it, modify either the policy or the simulation parameters, and run the task iteratively until the simulation behavior matches the input video.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体迭代接口。 输入一段执行真实任务的视频后，编码智能体可以通过相同的循环流程来调整模拟：修改场景、执行行为并观察结果。 RoboSimStudio 将一次运行分解为机器人的运动原语，并将模拟器状态转换为时空反馈，该反馈描述了目标误差、物体运动、接触事件、抓取或打滑情况，以及向任务目标推进的进度。 由于这种反馈是基于模拟器状态计算的，因此它能揭示仅凭图像难以推断的物理事件，例如接触。 结合视觉观察信息，这使得智能体能够将结果归因于导致该结果的动作，进而调整策略或模拟参数，并迭代执行任务，直到模拟行为与输入视频一致。

paragraphs.en: Human-in-the-Loop Agentic Real2Sim. RoboSimStudio allows humans and coding agents to interact with the same simulation during Real2Sim. While the coding agent constructs and modifies the scene, a human can observe the simulation through the interactive studio built on Viser, directly adjust physical parameters, and provide feedback to guide the agent. Changes made by the agent are reflected in the studio, allowing the human to evaluate simulated behavior against real-world observations. The human can also provide instructions and feedback asynchronously without interrupting the agent’s execution. This combines human guidance on task behavior and physical realism with the agent’s ability to construct scenes, debug simulation errors, and perform repeated evaluations. For example, when tuning a cable simulation, a human can use sliders in the Viser interface to adjust stiffness, damping, and contact parameters while observing the resulting cable behavior in real time. This provides immediate visual feedback for parameter exploration, while the coding agent can use the same parameters and simulation feedback for automated evaluation and refinement. The shared interface allows humans to provide feedback at a higher frequency and guide the agent toward appropriate physics models and parameters without interrupting its workflow.
paragraphs.zh: 人类介入的智能体驱动 Real2Sim。 RoboSimStudio 允许人类和编码智能体在 Real2Sim 过程中与同一模拟进行交互。 在编码智能体构建和修改场景的同时，人类可以通过基于 Viser 的交互式工作室观察模拟，直接调整物理参数并提供反馈以引导智能体。 智能体所做的更改会反映在工作室中，使人类能够将模拟行为与真实世界的观察结果进行比较评估。 人类还可以异步提供指令和反馈，而不会中断智能体的执行流程。 这种方式将人类对任务行为和物理真实性的指导，与智能体构建场景、调试模拟错误以及进行重复评估的能力相结合。 例如，在调整电缆模拟时，人类可以通过 Viser 界面中的滑块调整刚度、阻尼和接触参数，同时实时观察电缆的行为变化。 这为参数探索提供了即时视觉反馈，而编码智能体则可以利用相同的参数和模拟反馈进行自动化评估与优化。 共享界面使人类能够更频繁地提供反馈，并引导智能体选择适当的物理模型和参数，而不会中断其工作流程。

paragraphs.en: We first study human-guided Real2Sim using visual feedback. paragraphs.en: We study agentic Real2Sim2Real using a bimanual sponge-wiping task, where one robot arm holds a bar while the other uses a foam sponge to wipe off a marker stripe (Fig. 7(a) ). Given a smartphone video without CAD models or calibrated cameras, two off-the-shelf coding agents, Claude Fable 5.1 in Claude Code [ 1 ] and GPT-6 Astra in Codex [ 2 ] , independently constructed multi-physics simulations in RoboSimStudio in approximately one hour. The agents estimated scene geometry from the video, configured robot and object assets, and iteratively refined the simulation using visual observations and spatial-temporal feedback (Fig. 7(c) ). For example, simulator feedback helped identify errors in robot kinematics and contact conditions, allowing the agent to adjust the wiping motion and establish sponge contact with the bar. One agent constructed and verified the simulated task within 56 minutes.

paragraphs.en: Real-world Feedback and Simulation Refinement. We further study how RoboSimStudio supports iterative simulation refinement using feedback from real-world deployment. Given the failure video and a description of the observed failure, the coding agent identifies that the original simulation incorrectly fixes the bar supports to the environment. The agent modifies the scene by replacing the fixed constraint with a free rigid body, allowing the bar and its supports to move under contact forces (Fig. 7(i) ). The agent then evaluates the revised simulation under different wiping trajectories and contact conditions. While the original fixed-bar simulation cannot reproduce the observed displacement, the revised simulation captures bar motion and tipping when the sponge applies sufficient force or moves away from the bar’s center. This suggests how explicit physical constraints and editable scene parameters in RoboSimStudio allow coding agents to identify missing physical interactions and refine the simulation based on real-world observations. The revised simulation can then be used for further policy evaluation and improvement to reduce similar failures.
paragraphs.zh: 真实世界反馈与模拟优化。 我们进一步研究了 RoboSimStudio 如何利用来自真实世界部署的反馈支持迭代模拟优化。 根据故障视频和对所观察故障的描述，编码智能体识别出原始模拟错误地将杆件支撑固定到了环境中。 该智能体通过用自由刚体替换固定约束来修改场景，使杆件及其支撑能够在接触力作用下移动（图 7(i)）。 随后，该智能体在不同擦拭轨迹和接触条件下评估了优化后的模拟结果。 虽然原始固定杆件的模拟无法重现观察到的位移，但优化后的模拟能够捕捉到当海绵施加足够大的力或远离杆件中心时，杆件的移动和倾倒现象。 这表明 RoboSimStudio 中显式的物理约束和可编辑的场景参数，如何使编码智能体能够识别缺失的物理相互作用，并基于真实世界的观察结果对模拟进行优化。 优化后的模拟可用于进一步的策略评估与改进，以减少类似故障的发生。

sents.zh: 该智能体通过用自由刚体替换固定约束来修改场景，使杆件及其支撑能够在接触力作用下移动（图 7(i)）。

sents.en: The agent then evaluates the revised simulation under different wiping trajectories and contact conditions.
sents.zh: 随后，该智能体在不同擦拭轨迹和接触条件下评估了优化后的模拟结果。

sents.en: While the original fixed-bar simulation cannot reproduce the observed displacement, the revised simulation captures bar motion and tipping when the sponge applies sufficient force or moves away from the bar’s center.
sents.zh: 虽然原始固定杆件的模拟无法重现观察到的位移，但优化后的模拟能够捕捉到当海绵施加足够大的力或远离杆件中心时，杆件的移动和倾倒现象。

sents.en: This suggests how explicit physical constraints and editable scene parameters in RoboSimStudio allow coding agents to identify missing physical interactions and refine the simulation based on real-world observations.
sents.zh: 这表明 RoboSimStudio 中显式的物理约束和可编辑的场景参数，如何使编码智能体能够识别缺失的物理相互作用，并基于真实世界的观察结果对模拟进行优化。

sents.en: The revised simulation can then be used for further policy evaluation and improvement to reduce similar failures.
sents.zh: 优化后的模拟可用于进一步的策略评估与改进，以减少类似故障的发生。

paragraphs.en: We presented RoboSimStudio, an interactive toolkit for simulating robot manipulation that makes the choice of solver, contact model, and physical parameters explicit and editable. RoboSimStudio supports multi-physics simulation by coupling solvers within Newton and external physics engines, and provides interactive interfaces for both humans and coding agents to construct and refine simulations. We demonstrated its capabilities through 18 contact-rich manipulation tasks involving rigid bodies, articulated objects, cables, cloth, and soft-body deformation. In a pilot study of agentic Real2Sim2Real, coding agents constructed a multi-physics simulation of a bimanual sponge-wiping task from a smartphone video in approximately one hour. A Graph-as-Policy improved through simulation feedback was successfully deployed on the real robot, and real-world failure feedback was used to guide further simulation refinement.
paragraphs.zh: 我们介绍了 RoboSimStudio，这是一个用于模拟机器人操作的交互式工具包，它使求解器、接触模型和物理参数的选择变得明确且可编辑。 RoboSimStudio 通过耦合 Newton 内部的求解器和外部物理引擎来支持多物理场模拟，并为人类和编码智能体提供了交互式界面，以构建和优化模拟。 我们通过 18 个富含接触的操纵任务展示了其能力，这些任务涉及刚体、铰接物体、电缆、布料和软体变形。 在一项关于智能体驱动 Real2Sim2Real 的初步研究中，编码智能体利用智能手机视频在大约一小时内构建了一个双手海绵擦拭任务的多物理场模拟。 一种通过模拟反馈不断优化的“图即策略”方法成功部署到了真实机器人上，而现实世界中的失败反馈则被用于指导进一步的模拟优化。

paragraphs.en: Limitations and Future Work. This paper reports a developing system with a pilot study suggesting the feasibility of interactive and agentic Real2Sim2Real. The agentic simulation construction relies on existing material models, physics couplings, and robot assets provided by RoboSimStudio, and its capabilities remain limited by the supported physics solvers. Co-simulation with external physics engines also introduces computational overhead that may limit simulation throughput. Furthermore, we evaluated sim-to-real transfer on a single manipulation task, and assessed the agreement between simulated and real-world behavior primarily through qualitative observations. Future work will include more systematic quantitative evaluations across diverse manipulation tasks, including simulation accuracy, contact forces, object trajectories, agentic construction time, and real-world policy success rates.
paragraphs.zh: 局限性与未来工作。 本文报告了一个正在开发中的系统，一项初步研究结果表明了交互式智能体驱动 Real2Sim2Real 的可行性。 智能体驱动的模拟构建依赖于 RoboSimStudio 提供的现有材料模型、物理耦合和机器人资产，其能力仍受所支持物理求解器的限制。 与外部物理引擎进行协同模拟也会引入计算开销，这可能会限制模拟的吞吐量。 此外，我们仅在一个操作任务上评估了从模拟到现实的迁移效果，并主要通过定性观察来评估模拟行为与现实世界行为之间的一致性。 未来的工作将包括在多样化的操作任务中进行更系统化的定量评估，涵盖模拟准确性、接触力、物体轨迹、智能体构建时间以及现实世界中策略的成功率。
